rules.description:
You may add one of the following Harlequins units to your Army List:
● TROUPE MASTER
● SHADOWSEER
and one of either:
● LIGHT TROUPE
● DARK TROUPE
● TWILIGHT TROUPE
If you do add one or more of those units to your Army List, your Army Rules gains Mocking Misstep, Allegro Advance, Prismatic Pirouette and Kaleidoscopic Cavalcade.

selectionEntries.comment: EXTRA UNIT COPY COSTS / CURRENT. Permanent required accounting entry. Troop and Other arithmetic remain logically separate but live directly on this single visible parent. Kabalite Warriors, Wyches, Wracks, Kabalite Trueborn, Hekatrix Bloodbrides, and Haemoxytes remain the six native Troop copy families. Fifteen native non-Rare Other families retain the Other thresholds. Rare units and Roaming Performers imports remain outside the local ledger. Normal-copy allowances are Practice 4 / 1, Quick 4 / 1, Standard 6 / 2, and Long 8 / 3 for Troop / Other respectively. Each excess identical copy adds 20 Points.

selectionEntries.name: Updated: November 16th

rules.name: Patch Notes
rules.description:
# Drukhari 3.4

## New Content
• Khymerae (4–6): new Infantry unit at 20 points per model (80 points for four; up to two extra models at +20 each), with Nightmarish Talons, Daemonic and Stalking Warp-Beasts.

## Army-Wide Changes
• Power from Pain removed from applicable unit ability lists throughout the faction.
• Haemonculus is no longer Rare; it remains a Leader.
• Resilient 5+ added or retained on Haemonculus, Wracks, Haemoxytes, Grotesques, Cronos and Talos. Ur-Ghuls retain Resilient 4+. No other native Drukhari units have Resilient.

## Unit Abilities
• Archon: Drink of their Agony replaced by Oppressive Grandeur; added Archon's Ghostplate Armour.
• Haemonculus: Virtuoso of Anguish and Harvest Despair replaced by Twisted Fleshcraft; added Aberrant Grafting.
• Kabalite Warriors and Kabalite Trueborn: added Exhilarating Raid and Contemptuous Killers.
• Wyches and Hekatrix Bloodbrides: Graceful Acrobatics replaced by Spectacular Violence.
• Wracks and Haemoxytes: removed Twisted Fleshcraft; added Cruel Harvest.
• Raider: added Crippling Volleys.
• Venom: removed Flickerfield Flight; added Crippling Volleys.
• Incubi: Torturous Tormentors replaced by Ruthless Butchery.
• Grotesques: removed Twisted Fleshcraft.
• Scourges: added Ghostplate Armour.
• Reavers: Swift Strike renamed to Sadistic Speed; other ability names remain unchanged.
• Tantalus: removed Twilight Field; added Grav-Engines.
• Cronos: removed Twisted Fleshcraft; added Soul Drain.
• Talos: removed Twisted Fleshcraft.

## Equipment & Wargear
• Kabalite Warriors, Wyches, Kabalite Trueborn, Hekatrix Bloodbrides and Scourges: two independent optional Haywire/Plasma Grenade selections, costing 20 points each; Venomous Shardbomb remains 10 points and is limited to one selection per unit.
• Kabalite Warriors: Warriors 8–10 each choose a free Splinter Rifle or a +10-point Blaster, Shredder, Splinter Cannon or Dark Lance. Warriors 2–7 retain six fixed Splinter Rifles.
• Kabalite Trueborn: Trueborn 2–5 each choose a free Splinter Rifle or a +10-point Blaster, Shredder, Splinter Cannon or Dark Lance.
• Wracks: Wracks 2–5 each choose free Wrack Blades or a +10-point Hexrifle, Liquifier Gun or Ossefactor combined with Wrack Blades; the Acothyst remains unchanged.
• Haemoxytes: Haemoxytes 2–5 each choose free Wrack Blades or a +10-point Hexrifle, Liquifier Gun or Ossefactor combined with Wrack Blades; the Acothyst remains unchanged.
• Scourges: all six special weapon alternatives for Scourge 2 now cost +10 points; Shard Carbine remains free. Scourges 3–5 retain their existing +10-point upgrades.
• Raider, Venom and Ravager: removed Bladevanes weapon selections.
• Tantalus: removed Scythevanes weapon selection.
• Reavers: removed Reaver Bladevanes from the existing ranged-weapon loadouts.
• Wyches: Hekatarix Blades renamed to Hekatrix Blades.
• Hellions: Stunclaw upgrade now costs +10 points.

## Points & Unit Composition
• Kabalite Warriors: 140 → 100 points.
• Wyches: 120 → 110 points.
• Wracks: 120 → 100 points; unit size reduced from 10 to 5 models.
• Kabalite Trueborn: 100 → 110 points.
• Hekatrix Bloodbrides: 100 → 90 points.
• Haemoxytes: 80 → 140 points.
• Scourges: 150 → 120 points.
• Reavers: 100 → 90 points.
• Ravager: 110 → 100 points.
• Tantalus: 200 → 220 points.
• Hellions: 100 → 80 points.
• Talos: 120 → 130 points.

Full patch notes and rules can be found in the Reforged Discord Server:

https://discord.gg/BpjkaNmMVB

## Changelog (October 5th)

• Presentation: standardized Wracks and Haemoxytes final-state equipment package names to the source term `Wrack Blades`.
• Presentation: removed embedded Rules text from unit upgrades; upgrade choices, costs, and any Unit Ability labels remain unchanged.
• Presentation: increased spacing after ◆ unit markers so unit names remain clearly separated in roster exports.

## Changelog (September 29th)

• Presentation: removed redundant single-model headers so equipment appears directly beneath Loadout Options.

## Changelog (September 23rd)

• Presentation: replaced unit-row chevrons with ◆.
• Presentation: standardized ◆ unit markers to the project-wide two-space format in roster exports.
• 420 Point Practice: now uses 0 Leader Points and Quick-equivalent Extra Unit Copy Cost allowances; LP-costing units are hidden unless already selected.

## Changelog (September 21st)

• Standardized Configuration ordering across the listbuilder.
• Presentation: adopted the current emoji-enabled listbuilder presentation, including LP ⭐, 🏷️ Unit Abilities, 🧰 Loadout Options, and shared category icons.
• Unit Abilities: added all top-level Unit Ability names across the army.
• Added 420 Point Practice support.
• Archon Soul Trap now shows its Unit Ability only when the matching option is selected.
• Roaming Performers: synchronized with the current Harlequins shared library.
• Existing Leader Point, Attached Lhamaean, Rare, transport, Roaming Performers, and copy-cost behavior was preserved.

## Changelog (September 16th)

• Added model-count suffixes to Kabalite Warriors (10), Wyches (10), Wracks (10), Kabalite Trueborn (5), Hekatrix Bloodbrides (5), Haemoxytes (5), Incubi (5), Mandrakes (5), Grotesques (3), Ur-Ghuls (6), Scourges (5), Reavers (3), Clawed Fiends (6), and Razorwing Flock (6).
• Lhamaean: Attached Lhamaean is now presented as an optional checkbox instead of a radio button.
• Leader Points added to Archon, Haemonculus, Succubus, Beastmaster, and Lhamaean; imported Harlequin Leaders inherit their LP cost from the Harlequins shared library.
• Kabalite Warriors, Wyches, Wracks, Kabalite Trueborn, Hekatrix Bloodbrides, and Haemoxytes now correctly incur Extra Unit Copy Costs beyond the 4 / 6 / 8 Troop allowance.
• Reordered Helliarch, Arena Champion, Syren, Dracon, Hekatrix, Sybarite, Beastmaster, Succubus, Haemonculus, and Archon loadout presentation so melee options appear before pistols and fixed ranged/support weapons.
• Catalogue maintenance documentation was consolidated for the live catalogue.

RELEASE FINALIZATION (November 16, 2026): Drukhari 3.4 REV64 finalized from visually approved REV63 for the coordinated upload batch. Replaced provisional Patch Notes with the complete NR-relevant 3.4 release list; preserved dated Changelogs verbatim. No rules, loadouts, points, categories, costs, modifiers, selections, or IDs changed. Not yet uploaded.
PREVIOUS 3.3.5 RELEASE (September 29, 2026): Confirmed all relevant Drukhari 3.3.5 listbuilder changes are already present. Removed 11 redundant single-model Loadout Options wrapper groups (including the shared Lhamaean) without altering their existing equipment/default selection semantics. Retired only those wrapper IDs. Updated the existing Harlequins library link display label to the verified 3.3.9 name; stable library target ID unchanged. Minimal player-facing Patch Notes and a single presentation-only new Changelog entry. Uses Harlequins Library V27. No other mechanics changed. Earlier dated player-facing history remains unchanged.

REV64 / GS41 — DRUKHARI 3.4 RELEASE FINALIZATION (2026-11-16)
Closed the Open Revision following visual inspection of REV63. Replaced provisional 3.4 Patch Notes with the complete New Recruit-relevant published-datasheet change list, removed the unfinished-revision disclaimer, retained all existing historical Changelogs verbatim, and renamed catalogue / updated label to 3.4. This file is staged for a later batch upload; no upload has occurred. No army mechanics, unit options, model counts, points, costs, references, or IDs were modified in REV64.

REV62 / GS41 — DRUKHARI 3.4 OPEN REVISION: KHYMERAE + REMAINING EQUIPMENT FIXES (2026-11-16)
Added Khymerae (4-6) with a fixed 4x Nightmarish Talons core (80 points), two individually optional 20-point models using the Tyranids Ripper Swarms 4-6 Additional Model convention, name-only Daemonic and Stalking Warp-Beasts abilities, Other/Infantry classification, and its own eight Other copy-cost modifiers. Set Hellions Stunclaw upgrade to +10 points and renamed the Hekatrix model weapon in Wyches from Hekatarix Blades to Hekatrix Blades. Updated only provisional Patch Notes, retained historical Changelogs. Existing unit IDs, unrelated profiles, costs, abilities, loadouts, and selections unchanged.

REV61 / GS41 — DRUKHARI 3.4 OPEN REVISION: SCOURGE 2 SPECIAL WEAPON COSTS (2026-11-16)
Added +10 point costs to Scourge 2’s six special weapon choices. Shard Carbine remains free and the default; Solarite and Scourges 3–5, their option IDs, structure, constraints, and default IDs are unchanged. Updated only provisional 3.4 Patch Notes, retaining all historical Changelogs.

REV60 / GS41 — DRUKHARI 3.4 OPEN REVISION: HAEMOXYTES INDEPENDENT LOADOUTS (2026-11-16)
Replaced the three-model fixed Wrack Blades block and the single special-weapon model slot with four independent model-position weapon radios (Haemoxytes 2–5). Each defaults to free Wrack Blades and offers three +10-point alternatives. The Acothyst, unit points, Paid Wargear, abilities, categories, attachment constraints, and copy-cost accounting are unchanged. Updated only the provisional 3.4 Patch Notes, not historical Changelogs.

REV59 / GS41 — DRUKHARI 3.4 OPEN REVISION: KABALITE TRUEBORN INDEPENDENT WEAPONS (2026-11-16)
Replaced the consolidated 3x Splinter Rifle block and single special-weapon slot with four independent model-position radios for Trueborn 2–5. Each has a free Splinter Rifle default plus four +10-point weapon alternatives. Preserved Dracon, attached Lhamaean, grenade selections, unit cost, categories, abilities, copy-cost calculations, and all related host rules. Existing compatible IDs preserved, unique IDs added for new positions. Provisional 3.4 Patch Notes updated; historical Changelogs untouched.

REV58 / GS41 — DRUKHARI 3.4 OPEN REVISION: WRACKS FIVE-MODEL LOADOUT (2026-11-16)
Replaced the Wracks (10) 120-point entry with Wracks (5) at 100 points. Preserved the Acothyst and the original unit ID, category, attachment, ability, and copy-cost semantics. Four independently equipped Wracks now each use one mandatory selector with free Wrack Blades or +10-point Hexrifle/Liquifier Gun/Ossefactor combined with Wrack Blades. Updated the Haemonculus eligibility message and the Wracks childName in the established copy-cost accounting. Added only currently implemented changes to the provisional 3.4 Patch Notes; historical Changelogs remain unchanged.

REV57 / GS41 — DRUKHARI 3.4 OPEN REVISION: KABALITE WARRIORS SPECIAL WEAPONS (2026-11-16)
Kabalite Warriors (10) retain the Sybarite and 100-point base unit. Changed Kabalite Warriors 2–8 from a 7x rifle block to Warriors 2–7 with 6x Splinter Rifle; added independent Warrior 8 loadout. Warriors 8–10 each now choose one free default Splinter Rifle or a +10-point Blaster, Shredder, Splinter Cannon, or Dark Lance. Existing Warrior 9/10 weapon IDs and all unrelated selections preserved. Provisional 3.4 Patch Notes updated; existing Changelogs unchanged.

REV56 / GS41 — 3.4 OPEN REVISION: SKIMMER WEAPON REMOVAL (2026-11-16)
Removed fixed Bladevanes selectors and their now-empty mandatory radio groups from Raider, Venom, and Ravager; removed fixed Scythevanes selector and its mandatory radio from Tantalus. Removed the Reaver Bladevanes suffix from five existing atomic ranged-weapon labels across Reavers 1–3; retained original choices, IDs, defaults, costs, and all skimmer unit abilities. Updated only the provisional 3.4 Patch Notes; no other equipment or rules changed.

REV54 / GS41 — POWER FROM PAIN AUDIT + HAEMONCULUS RARE REMOVAL (2026-11-16)
Confirmed Power from Pain already has no active unit, nested, or shared-profile references following REV53; its only occurrence remains in provisional Patch Notes describing the removal. Removed the Haemonculus Rare category and its former one-per-roster Rare error, preserving its Leader identity, 1 LP cost, attachment requirement, equipment, and other rules. No Extra Unit Copy Costs applied to this Leader. No changes to other units or deferred Wracks composition.

REV53 / GS41 — DRUKHARI 3.4 OPEN REVISION, FIRST IMPLEMENTATION PASS (2026-11-16)
Starting from the released Drukhari 3.3.5 REV52 baseline, implemented 3.4 point deltas for 11 units (Wracks point cost intentionally deferred), the confirmed top-level Unit Ability removals/renames/additions, and a roster-wide Resilient profile audit. Ur-Ghuls retain Resilient 4+, the six other designated units receive Resilient 5+, and no other unit has Resilient. Preserved Reavers Death-Racers; only Swift Strike was renamed to Sadistic Speed. No loadout, model size, relic, Rare category, or weapon changes were made. Original historical Changelog retained. Unpublished 3.4 Open Revision; later changes to follow.

REV52 / GS41 — UNIT MARKER EXPORT SPACING (FIGURE SPACE FINAL)
Replaced the two ordinary spaces after the ◆ unit marker with one U+2007 FIGURE SPACE across executable unit names and childName mirrors. This preserves the intended visual gap in New Recruit roster exports. Updated the player-facing Changelog from the frozen canonical source. No points, profiles, constraints, associations, categories, or other listbuilding mechanics changed.

REV51 / GS41 — CANONICAL PATCH NOTES / CHANGELOG SYNC
Replaced the player-facing Patch Notes and Changelog text with the frozen canonical source. No catalogue mechanics, IDs, costs, constraints, profiles, associations, categories, or listbuilding behavior changed.

REV50 / GS41 — WRACK BLADES NAMING + COMMENT CLEANUP
Standardized the player-facing Wracks and Haemoxytes final-state equipment package names to the source weapon name `Wrack Blades`; no loadout legality, costs, defaults, constraints, IDs, or weapon choices changed. Updated the matching local authoring comments. Also refreshed the Extra Unit Copy Costs comment to the current Practice 4 Troop / 1 Other allowance and corrected CURRENT STATE to Drukhari 3.3.5 / GS41 with Harlequins 3.3.9 - Library V27. Added one October 4th Changelog entry for the player-facing naming cleanup. All unrelated mechanics remain unchanged.

REV49 / GS41 — UNIT UPGRADE RULE-TEXT CLEANUP
Removed embedded local Rules text from 2 unit upgrade selections. Upgrade selection IDs, costs, constraints, modifiers, profile links, Unit Ability labels, loadout logic, and all executable listbuilding mechanics are unchanged. Only the 2 local descriptive rule IDs attached to those upgrades were retired. Added one consolidated October 2nd presentation entry to the player-facing Changelog.

REV48 / GS41 — SEPTEMBER 29 FINAL AUDIT
Confirmed all relevant Drukhari 3.3.5 listbuilder changes are already present. Removed 11 redundant single-model Loadout Options wrapper groups (including the shared Lhamaean) without altering their existing equipment/default selection semantics. Retired only those wrapper IDs. Updated the existing Harlequins library link display label to the verified 3.3.9 name; stable library target ID unchanged. Minimal player-facing Patch Notes and a single presentation-only new Changelog entry. Uses Harlequins Library V27. No other mechanics changed.

REV47 / GS41 — REAVER ARENA CHAMPION OPTIONAL-WARGEAR PRESENTATION
Replaced the REV46 unit-level Cluster Caltrops checkbox with a third model-specific one-of-three radio group under the topmost Arena Champion: a genuinely empty preselected option, Cluster Caltrops +10, or Grav-Talon +10. The original Cluster Caltrops option and its source-derived rule text retain their IDs; its former max-1 constraint now applies to the radio group. This corrects the still-unreleased Reavers 3.3.5 update. Updated draft Patch Notes without altering any historical Changelog text. No other gameplay changes.

REV46 / GS41 — DRUKHARI 3.3.5 RULES UPDATE
Incubi 120 Points; Reavers 100 Points. Reavers gain Death-Racers and Swift Strike Unit Ability profiles. Their equipment uses Reaver Bladevanes as the renamed weapon. No player-facing Changelog wording, IDs, targets, costs, LP, constraints, modifiers, associations, loadouts, category ownership, copy-cost arithmetic, Practice behavior, or other executable mechanics changed.

Historical revision notes and separate shared-library/version references remain unchanged for their own audit passes. REV40 / GS40 — PRACTICE DESCRIPTION CLEANUP COMPATIBILITY
Retargeted to Game System revision 40 after removal of redundant construction-summary text from the 420 Point Practice description. No catalogue-local executable data changed in this revision: Practice LP visibility, explicit 0-LP attachment-only exceptions where present, Extra Unit Copy Cost arithmetic, points, IDs, loadouts, associations, and all unit mechanics remain unchanged.

REV39 / GS39 — PRACTICE ZERO-LP MIGRATION
This component now targets Game System revision 39. Every locally owned unit root carrying a positive LP cost receives selected-safe Practice hiding: it is hidden while 420 Point Practice is active only when that unit is not already selected. Explicit 0-LP roots do not exist under the project convention, so no exception tags are required. The local Extra Unit Copy Costs Practice branch is now an exact clone of the current Quick branch, giving Practice four normal-cost Troop copies and one normal-cost Other copy. Points, intrinsic LP costs, IDs, loadouts, associations, category ownership, Quick/Standard/Long arithmetic, and unrelated mechanics are unchanged.

CURRENT SYSTEM-WIDE CONFIGURATION ORDER / GS38
This catalogue now targets Game System revision 38. Configuration presentation follows the shared lane doctrine: provenance warning 5 when applicable; Game Size 10; army identity 20; optional army structure 30; Leader Points 40; faction trackers 50; Extra Unit Copy Costs 80; Updated 90; About 100. Only locally-owned applicable lanes are stored in this file; Game Size, Leader Points, and About are supplied by the Game System. No unit IDs, costs, constraints, modifiers, attachment topology, loadout legality, or copy-cost arithmetic were changed by this pass.

CURRENT STATE
Drukhari 3.3.5 targets Game System revision 41 and uses the current Leader Points, Practice, Extra Unit Copy Costs, Unit Abilities, and presentation infrastructure. Roaming Performers remains fully integrated through the linked Harlequins 3.3.9 - Library V27 and defaults to Not Included. Native Leader attachments, nested Attached Lhamaean behavior, Rare validation, loadouts, and Harlequin constructive validation remain live and stable.

Archon, Haemonculus, Succubus, Beastmaster, and the shared nested Lhamaean retain their existing 1 LP costs. Lhamaean remains a complete nested Leader that may coexist with one normal attached Leader and is presented as a checkbox under Kabalite Warriors, Wyches, Kabalite Trueborn, and Hekatrix Bloodbrides.

Extra Unit Copy Costs uses one visible accounting entry while preserving distinct Troop and Other arithmetic. Kabalite Warriors, Wyches, Wracks, Kabalite Trueborn, Hekatrix Bloodbrides, and Haemoxytes remain the six native Troop copy families. Fourteen native non-Rare Other families retain their established copy accounting; Rare units remain outside it. Practice / Quick / Standard / Long normal-copy allowances are 4 / 4 / 6 / 8 for Troops and 1 / 1 / 2 / 3 for Other.

AUTHORING & RUNTIME NOTES
Source-derived rules remain player authority. Top-level Unit Ability names are represented as shared Profiles and linked to all 26 native/shared Drukhari datasheets; nested sub-abilities are intentionally omitted. Unit rows use ◆; Loadout Options use 🧰; native model headers use the faction-default 🩸; and listbuilder-relevant Leader Attachment / Attached Lhamaean labels use 🔗.

Roaming Performers selected units remain visible and receive constructive repair errors when the Configuration is missing or set to Not Included. One Roaming Leader and one Roaming Troupe remain permitted. The five local Harlequin entryLinks use the current medal-free shared-library names with the ◆  row presentation. Stable Harlequin target IDs and the Drukhari availability/validation wrappers remain unchanged.

OPTIONAL UNIT ABILITY PRESENTATION: top-level abilities granted by selectable options are linked to the granting selection rather than the unit root. Soul Trap is therefore linked to the Archon's Soul Trap weapon/ability choice and appears only when that option is selected.

HISTORICAL REVISION LOG
REV18: New Recruit cost-type compatibility. REV19-21: presentation and constructive-error polish. REV22-28: Reaver, Scourge, Grotesque, Haemoxyte, Bloodbride, Wrack, and Wych atomic/final-state loadout cleanup. REV29: GS20 Troop rule links plus fixed Hellion and Mandrake packages. REV30: standard Patch Notes. REV31: Drukhari 3.3.4 / GS21 baseline. REV32: melee-first presentation. REV33: completed executable Troop Additional Copy Costs accounting and consolidated current-state documentation.
REV34: Leader Points migration. Archon, Haemonculus, Succubus, Beastmaster, and the shared nested Lhamaean now each cost 1 LP. LP is owned by the semantic unit root exactly once. The legacy Counts Toward Leader Maximum tags and the host-side conditional category modifiers used to make nested Lhamaeans visible to the old count validator are intentionally preserved unchanged during dual-system migration. Roaming Performers and all imported Harlequin roots remain untouched until the Harlequins/shared-library migration. Retargeted to Game System revision 24. No attachment, Rare, contingent, Additional Copy Cost, points, loadout, or other faction mechanics changed.

REV35 — LEADER POINTS CLEANUP + LHAMAEN CHECKBOX
Runtime validation passed for ordinary native Leaders, nested Lhamaean LP accounting, and imported Harlequin Leader inheritance. The five legacy Counts Toward Leader Maximum links matched the five native/shared 1-LP Leader roots exactly and were removed. The four host-side conditional category modifiers that existed solely to feed nested Lhamaean into the old count validator were also removed. Host attachment-limit errors remain Association-based and unchanged. Attached Lhamaean presentation under Kabalite Warriors, Wyches, Kabalite Trueborn, and Hekatrix Bloodbrides now uses the project checkbox convention: the existing max-one constraint was moved from the single-choice group onto the Lhamaean entryLink while preserving its ID. Harlequin imports remain locally uncharged. Roaming Performers, Rare, attachment legality, Troop soft-copy cost accounting, Additional Copy Costs, points, loadouts, and all unrelated Drukhari mechanics remain unchanged. Patch Notes presentation was updated to the September 14th cleanup convention.

REV36 — UNIT SIZE NAME PRESENTATION
Added source model-count suffixes to Kabalite Warriors (10), Wyches (10), Wracks (10), Kabalite Trueborn (5), Hekatrix Bloodbrides (5), Haemoxytes (5), Incubi (5), Mandrakes (5), Grotesques (3), Ur-Ghuls (6), Scourges (5), Reavers (3), Clawed Fiends (6), and Razorwing Flock (6). Stable unit IDs, points, categories, loadouts, attachment topology, Additional Copy Cost arithmetic, Leader Points, and validation mechanics are unchanged. childName metadata and constructive error text were synchronized to the new visible root names. The touched catalogue now targets current GS27.
REV37 — CURRENT TEMPLATE / PRACTICE / UNIT ABILITIES / ROAMING PERFORMERS SYNC
Consolidated current-template update from the live REV36 baseline. Retargeted to Game System revision 37; added 420 Point Practice compatibility to Extra Unit Copy Costs; flattened the visible Troops/Other accounting children into one Extra Unit Copy Costs entry while preserving all existing Quick/Standard/Long arithmetic; adopted the current unit/loadout/model/category/attachment presentation renamed Hellions to Hellions (5); added top-level Unit Ability profiles from the supplied Drukhari ability map; and synchronized the five local Roaming Performers entryLink names to the existing Harlequins V17 source names. Harlequins V17 itself remains unchanged.
REV55 — GRENADE PAID WARGEAR (OPEN REVISION, 2026-11-16)
Updated Paid Wargear on Kabalite Warriors, Wyches, Kabalite Trueborn, Hekatrix Bloodbrides, and Scourges only. Kept two existing independent optional grenade slot groups, removed Venomous Shardbomb from those radios, set Haywire/Plasma to +20 points, and moved a single +10 Venomous Shardbomb into a direct max-one checkbox entry. Preserved existing slot/weapon IDs where retained. Provisional 3.4 Patch Notes updated; prior Changelogs untouched.

REV63 — GRENADE GROUP HEADER CLEANUP (OPEN REVISION, 2026-11-16)
Renamed the two optional grenade selection groups inside Paid Wargear to the catalogue’s established invisible group label for Kabalite Warriors, Wyches, Kabalite Trueborn, Hekatrix Bloodbrides, and Scourges. Both independent max-one selection groups, all IDs, costs, entries, and constraints remain unchanged. Provisional Patch Notes and historical Changelogs unchanged.
